# Advanced Renderer Source Provenance

This is the source-of-truth inventory for renderer material studied or copied
from upstream projects. A repository appearing here does not make it a build
dependency and does not mean its features exist in Media Server.

## Reviewed references

| Reference | Reviewed revision | License at review | Intended use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [SpartanEngine](https://github.com/PanosK92/SpartanEngine) | `4842e83cecaee6f2bb86cdc1aa183e881569a8dc` | MIT | Native D3D12/RHI, GPU-driven raster, ray-query, ReSTIR, TAAU, diagnostics concepts |
| [Atlas-Engine](https://github.com/tippesi/Atlas-Engine) | tag `0.2.0`, commit `76e4916e55706c0f6eac971d17d65bd8feacf70e` | MIT code; sample data excluded | Host-owned/headless lifetime and DDGI concepts/shaders |
| [hybrid-rendering](https://github.com/diharaw/hybrid-rendering) | tag `1.1.0`, commit `090360e0b231e6df38f0c0ce0b7465c8f8485b0e` | MIT | RT and SVGF/A-trous algorithm reference |

These are immutable research pins. Updates require a new reviewed commit and a
separate audit; a tag moving upstream does not change this record.

## Incorporated-file inventory

No source, shader, binary, sample scene, texture, model, capture, or other
asset from the three references is incorporated in this repository at this
revision. The native RHI and Advanced raster implementation were written for
Media Server against public D3D12/DXGI APIs after the references were studied.
There is consequently no donor file in the product build or release payload.

Before any donor file is added, this section must gain one row per file with:

| Upstream path | Upstream revision | Local path | License/notice | Modifications | Conformance evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| _None_ | | | | | |

The exact upstream notices captured during the audit are retained in
`licenses/` even though no donor file was copied. If a donor file is added,
its notice must also be included in release notices. Source headers are
retained. Shader ports record both the original path and the new HLSL path.
Generated bytecode records the reviewed source and compiler inputs.

The inspected paths, build attempts, workstation details, and capture gaps are
recorded in [REFERENCE-AUDIT.md](REFERENCE-AUDIT.md).

## Exclusions

- Donor root builds, application loops, window/input/audio systems, ECS,
  serialization, editor/ImGui code, scripting, physics, and unrelated tools.
- Atlas sample data and all demo media/assets unless production redistribution
  rights are independently verified and recorded here.
- Precompiled shaders or binaries whose exact source, toolchain, and license
  cannot be reproduced.
- Any code whose runtime assumes an engine-owned global device or swapchain;
  it must first be adapted to Media Server's host-owned renderer contract.

## Update procedure

1. Review the candidate upstream diff from the recorded pin and verify the
   license at the candidate revision.
2. Build the candidate upstream renderer unchanged and capture reference
   output, feature requirements, and GPU timing outside the product build.
3. Copy only the required file or port the required algorithm; update the
   incorporated-file table and release notices in the same commit.
4. Keep donor types behind `engine/rhi` or `engine/render`; never expose donor
   world, window, input, clock, or swapchain ownership to the application.
5. Run the renderer/RHI conformance suite and the full Debug and Release build
   matrices before accepting the update.
